US9589231B2.description: A patent document titled "Social medical network for diagnosis assistance" that describes a method and system for assisting medical diagnosis by exploiting similarity between new medical cases and existing cases and experts in a common embedding space.

Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.entity_name: Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Assistance
Social Medical Network For Diagnosis Ass.description: The title of patent US9589231B2, referring to a network-based approach for assisting diagnosis through similarity matching of medical cases and experts.

Diagnosis Assistance Method.description: A method that receives a query request including a new medical case, embeds the new case in an embedding space containing existing medical cases and experts, allows selection between query-for-cases and query-for-experts, and returns subsets based on computed similarity.

Embedding Space.description: A common multidimensional space in which new medical cases, existing medical cases, and experts are embedded so that similarity between their representations can be computed.

New Medical Case.description: A medical case submitted by a requester in a query request, comprising a plurality of records relating to a specific patient, which is embedded in the embedding space for similarity comparison.

Existing Medical Cases.description: A set of previously stored medical cases that are embedded in the embedding space and compared against a new medical case to return a similar subset.

Experts.description: A set of medical experts embedded in the embedding space based on information such as their profile, coded medical procedures performed, authored articles, and linked stored medical cases, who may be selected to formulate a diagnosis.

Requester.description: A user who submits a query request including a new medical case and selects from available query types.

Query-For-Cases.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of existing medical cases based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded existing cases.

Query-For-Experts.description: A query type that, when selected, returns a subset of experts based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and the embedded experts.

Query Cost.description: A computed cost for a query, where the cost for a query-for-experts differs from and is higher than the cost for a query-for-cases, encouraging requesters to try query-by-cases first.

Medical Ontology.description: A structure comprising a set of medical concepts joined by links, each concept corresponding to a dimension in the multidimensional representation, used as the basis for embedding medical cases and experts.

Multidimensional Representation.description: A computed representation of a medical case based on a medical ontology, used to embed the case in the embedding space.

Matrix Of Proximities.description: A matrix applied to the multidimensional representation of a new case that accounts for relationships between concepts in the ontology when computing similarity measures.

Unified Medical Language System.description: A system on which the medical ontology may be based.

Human Body Parts.description: One of the categories of concepts that the ontology may include.

Biological Functions.description: One of the categories of concepts that the ontology may include.

Medical Conditions.description: One of the categories of concepts that the ontology may include.

Pharmacological Substances.description: One of the categories of concepts that the ontology may include.

Expert Profile.description: Information about an expert used as a basis for embedding the expert in the embedding space.

Coded Medical Procedures.description: Medical procedures performed by an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert.

Authored Articles.description: Articles authored by an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert.

Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.entity_name: Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert
Stored Medical Cases Linked To Expert.description: Medical cases linked to an expert, used as a basis for embedding the expert.

Expert Availability.description: An attribute of an expert that may be used, along with similarity, to return the subset of experts for a query-for-experts.

Expert Rating.description: A rating of an expert that may be used, along with similarity, to return the subset of experts for a query-for-experts.

Expert Followers.description: The number of followers of an expert among users of the system, which may be used to return the subset of experts.

Public Database.description: A database from which documents may be returned based on computed similarity between the embedded new case and embedded documents when the query-for-cases is selected.

Diagnosis.description: The medical determination that a selected expert attempts to formulate for a new case provided to the expert.

Payment.description: A payment made to an expert for formulating a diagnosis when the query-for-experts is selected.

Patient Records.description: A plurality of records relating to a specific patient that make up the new medical case, including laboratory test results, images, symptom descriptions, patient monitor results, diagnoses, prescribed medications and treatments.

Laboratory Test Results.description: A type of patient record that may be included in the new medical case.

Medical Images.description: A type of patient record that may be included in the new medical case.

Symptom Descriptions.description: A type of patient record that may be included in the new medical case.

Patient Monitor Results.description: A type of patient record that may be included in the new medical case.

Prescribed Medications And Treatments.description: A type of patient record that may be included in the new medical case.

Diagnosis Assistance System.description: A system comprising memory storing instructions for performing the diagnosis assistance method and a processor in communication with the memory for executing the instructions.

Computer Program Product.description: A product comprising a non-transitory recording medium storing instructions that, when executed on a computer, cause the computer to perform the diagnosis assistance method.

Computer Processor.description: A processor that performs at least one of the embedding, providing, returning subsets, and computing query cost steps of the method.
